address: Plaza de Abastos, Santiago de Compostela, 15704, Spain
bio: A unique restaurant occupying six small market stalls in the city’s main food market, the Mercado de Abastos, which is the second most visited sight in Santiago after the majestic cathedral. You’ll need to book ahead as the restaurant only has a single shared large table where the focus is on “raciones”, modern tapas and wines by the glass. They also offer personalised menus from 50€ upwards....
